rules.name: The Red Moderation Rule
rules.body: Kumwell Red is used selectively on <= 15% of any page layout to maintain its impact.

dos: Do maintain a strict 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all status descriptions and body labels.
donts: Don't use neon accent shadows or glowing button edges.
